text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I start to feel a little hungry while out
one day
with Inari One.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wanna grab some food? What're ya in
the mood
for?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ya just leavin' it up to me? Are ya
sure
you're fine with anythin'?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. Anythin' is fine then, huh...
choice_data_list: Hmm... As long as it fills the stomach...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, that makes things more interestin'!
I just had
a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Let's spice things up. Whaddya say to
drawin' lots
to decide where we go eat?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! Let's find some paper to
fold.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sweet! That oughta do it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and draw one. Once ya unfold
it, you'll
see the restaurant's name.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Curious, are we? I was just 'bout to tell
ya.
choice_data_list: By the way, what kind of places are you considering?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
First on the list is Hyper Mala Blackout.
They're
famous in the neighborhood for
their super spicy
hot pot.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh. Crack the lid off the pot of
hell, and
witness the sea of crimson
flames. One bite and
you'll breathe fire
for three days!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But, don't go writin' the others off just
yet.
There's also Supersize Dojo, the
place where
competitive eaters clash
each day, and leavin'
food uneaten is a
cardinal sin.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Then, there's Survival Instinct, where
they
specialize in bug cuisine. You'll
need courage if
you're gonna try this
one, though. I've written
down tons more
interestin' places, too! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah yeah, I almost forgot! There's also
the
long-standin' rice ball joint
Prosperity Hut. Their
inari sushi is to die
for!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh, we agreed to let the gods
decide this
one. Go on and make your
draw!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I said I was up for anything, I
didn't expect
this... I cross my fingers in
hopes of drawing the
last mentioned
restaurant and nervously pull a
folded
sheet.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya know? It's the Prosperity Hut! I
gotta
say, luck is really on your side!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. That settles it, let's head there
now! I
know some nice scenic spots
nearby too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we make our way over to the
restaurant.
After purchasing our inari
sushi, Inari One leads
me to her
recommended spot.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, yeah! This is the good stuff! I can't
get
enough of this salty-sweet flavor!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think, Trainer? Doesn't it taste
better
knowin' you hit the jackpot in the
draw?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I immediately nod in agreement, which
sets Inari
off snickering.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Pfft... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorry, Trainer. It was me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The raffle we made... Well, I kinda only
put the
rice ball restaurant in.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, ya said anythin' was fine. I
couldn't help
but yank your chain a li'l
bit.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But now, doesn't it feel even better to
be eatin'
tasty food in front of a fine
view like this?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But now, doesn't it feel even better to
be eatin'
tasty food in front of a fine
view like this?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya can't take even a single meal for
granted. It's
important to take care of
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The world's a harsh place, after all.
Things won't
always go the way ya
planned.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's why ya gotta keep a cool head.
Whatever
life throws at ya, stand tall
and enjoy the ride!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One talks while gazing at the sky.
Maybe
this little stunt is her way of
sharing her Edo spirit
with me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oops, there I go ramblin' on. Well
anyway, havin'
that kind of mindset is
what I mean when I talk
about style and
class.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oops, there I go ramblin' on. Well
anyway, havin'
that kind of mindset is
what I mean when I talk
about style and
class.
choice_data_list: I'd love to be someone with that kind of flair too.
I want to be someone with that kind of flair too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, ya don't needa work too hard at it.
Ya got a
role model standing right next
to ya!
choice_data_list: I'd love to be someone with that kind of flair too.
I want to be someone with that kind of flair too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That said, don't expect me to keep
shootin' my
mouth off all the time. Long
explanations are the
epitome of tacky.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the day, just follow my
lead!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Didja not listen to a word I said?!
Geez!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's fine. I was goofin' around with
ya too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Enjoy the food to your heart's content.
Heh heh.
